words.trans: adj. 刷石灰水的（刷白，用来防腐防虫）
examples: The old wooden boat, with her tarred hull and lime-washed decks, blended into the surroundings.
The village church had lime-washed walls that glowed in the sun.

words.trans: adj. 涂了焦油的；tar 的过去式/过去分词，给…涂焦油
examples: The old wooden boat, with her tarred hull, blended into the surroundings.
Sailors used to tar the ropes to keep them from rotting.

words.trans: n. 桤木，一种水边生长的树木
examples: The boat blended into the surroundings as easily as the twisted alders that fringed the shore.
Alders grow abundantly along the damp riverbank.

words.trans: n. 专指交通工具上的厨房（船、邮轮、飞机、老式火车）。空间狭窄狭长，受船体/机舱限制，设备紧凑
examples: Tom rapped on the galley window before climbing aboard.
Jim got to work in the cramped galley of the houseboat.

words.trans: n.【航海】碰垫；护舷材；防撞绳垫。挂在船舷外侧，橡胶/绳索做的缓冲物，船靠岸、两船相靠时垫在船体之间防磕碰刮伤
examples: Tom killed the engine and let Maggot drift into the rope fender.
He hung a fender over the side to stop the boat scraping the quay.

words.trans: v. 1.笃笃地敲；急促轻叩（本文含义） 2.说唱
examples: Tom rapped on the galley window.
Someone rapped sharply on the door and demanded entry.

words.trans: v. 挤压；把…挤在一起；压扁
examples: Maggie and Joel were squashed together on a bench.
Five kids were squashed into the back of the tiny car.

words.trans: adv. 心不在焉地，出神地（文学小说里几乎都表示精神走神、心思飘走、漫不经心，不是物理上不在现场）
examples: Tom paced about, absently looking at the framed photos.
She twirled her hair absently while lost in thought.

words.trans: n. 接骨木花；西洋接骨木的白色花簇，用来做饮品、糖浆
examples: He brought out a bottle of home-made elderflower cordial.
In summer the hedge was thick with fragrant elderflower.

words.trans: n. 浓缩果花甜糖浆（需兑水稀释饮用）  adj. 热诚的，友善的
examples: He brought out a bottle of home-made elderflower cordial.
She was given a glass of fruit cordial diluted with water.

words.trans: adj. 冒泡的，充满气泡的。fizzy water 可指含糖汽水；sparkling water 专指无糖气泡水，不会联想到可乐雪碧
examples: He brought out some elderflower cordial and fizzy water.
The child loved the fizzy feel of lemonade on his tongue.

words.trans: 固定短语：空腹、肚子饿着
examples: No one thinks well on an empty stomach.
You shouldn't take these tablets on an empty stomach.

words.trans: n.（动物，尤指狗、狐狸等）口鼻部（本文含义）；嘴筒
examples: He added, rubbing Archie's muzzle.
The dog wore a muzzle to stop it biting.

words.trans: v. 摆弄，拨弄；做小动作，漫不经心地摸来摸去
examples: Tom fiddled with his untouched glass.
He sat fiddling nervously with the buttons of his coat.

words.trans: n. 月桂叶（复数 bay leaves）
examples: He tore up a couple of bay leaves and scattered them on the fish.
A single bay leaf adds flavour to the stew.

words.trans: 经典高频固定习语。字面让嘴巴流口水；实际翻译：令人垂涎、馋得直流口水
examples: The cabin filled with an aroma that made their mouths water.
The smell of fresh bread makes my mouth water.

words.trans: prep.【法语外来词】在…的家里；在…的住处
examples: Then we'll be ready for char and chips, chez Matilda!
Tonight's dinner is chez us — you're all invited.

words.trans: 向某人完整通报情况、把前因后果全部讲清楚，把消息补全告诉对方
examples: Tom filled Jim in on everything they knew.
Let me fill you in on the latest news.

words.trans: adj. 珍珠般的；珍珠色的，泛着乳白温润光泽的
examples: As they ate the pearly flesh, they burnt their mouths on the chips.
She had a lovely pearly complexion.

words.trans: n.（鱼肉、动物的）肉，肉质
examples: As they ate the pearly flesh of the fish.
The fish flesh was soft and flaky.

words.trans: 轻松随意地闲聊，碎碎念，东拉西扯，不一定聊严肃正事（chatter 喋喋不休、叽叽喳喳说个不停）
examples: While we were chattering away, Tom's got it all worked out.
The children chattered away happily throughout lunch.

words.trans: 把事情全部想通、盘算清楚，琢磨出解决方案
examples: Tom's got it all worked out!
Don't worry about the trip — I'll get it all worked out.

words.trans: 袖手旁观；坐视不理；安坐一旁不采取行动。暗含你有能力介入，但选择往后退、什么都不干
examples: We can't sit back and do nothing.
You can't just sit back and expect everything to work out by itself.

words.trans: adv. 未免有点；实在过于（带轻微评价、略有一点不以为然的语气）
examples: Said Joel, rather too matter-of-factly, given the enormity of what this involved.
It's rather too expensive for my budget.

words.trans: n. 1.事情的重大程度；严重性；巨大的风险/后果  2.滔天恶行，残暴的罪行
examples: Given the enormity of what this was going to involve.
They slowly grasped the enormity of the disaster.

words.trans: 字面拖干净；擦干；（文中）用食物把盘里汤汁、碎屑蘸干净
examples: Maggie mopped up some salt with the last chip.
He used the bread to mop up the sauce on his plate.

words.trans: n. 1.（坦克、军舰的）旋转炮塔（本文）  2.塔楼，角楼
examples: Joel turned his head like the rotating turret of a tank.
The soldier ducked back inside the tank's turret.

words.trans: adj. 经过改装的；经过改造适配
examples: Just a couple of adapted multi-rotors with blue lights.
The van was adapted to be used as an ambulance.

words.trans: （完整 the game is up）把戏败露了；你们完蛋了；计划已经暴露。一般直接对做坏事的人说：你们的阴谋被识破，没有机会继续下去
examples: So we tell them they're surrounded, and the game's up?
When the police arrived, the thieves knew the game was up.

words.trans: adj. 同时发生的（副词 simultaneously）
examples: We can buzz them simultaneously using Skylark and two hexacopters.
There were simultaneous explosions in three different cities.

words.trans: n. 六轴无人机（hexa- = 六；copter = helicopter 旋翼飞行器）
examples: We can buzz them using Skylark and two hexacopters.
A hexacopter has six rotors for extra stability.

words.trans: n. 狗鱼（淡水大型掠食鱼）
examples: There was a picture of Jim holding a huge pike by the gills.
He caught a large pike in the deep part of the lake.

words.trans: n. 鱼鳃（gill 的复数）
examples: He held a huge pike by the gills.
A fish breathes through its gills.

words.trans: v. 眉开眼笑，笑容灿烂，喜气洋洋地笑（开怀的大笑，不是浅浅微笑）。beam at camera 满面春风灿烂地笑（情绪更强）
examples: They were beaming at the camera.
The old man beamed with pride when his grandson won.

words.trans: 时隔这么久，过了这么多年
examples: He still wore his wedding ring after all this time.
After all this time, she still remembered his kindness.

words.word: puff out a cloud of smoke
words.trans: v.（抽烟）一口吐出烟雾；噗地喷出
examples: He puffed out a cloud of blue smoke.
The old engine puffed out a cloud of black smoke.

words.trans: 字面听见自己在低语。文学含义：不由自主低声说出，几乎是下意识脱口而出
examples: Tom heard himself whisper: 'No, Jim.'
She was so shocked she heard herself whisper in disbelief.

words.trans: 带有目的，为了突出优点、特色而专门展出
examples: They want to showcase some local delicacies.
The fair showcases traditional crafts from the region.

words.trans: n. 珍馐，特色佳肴（delicacy 复数）。local delicacies 地方特色美食
examples: They want to showcase some local delicacies.
The restaurant is famous for its seafood delicacies.

words.trans: adj.（烹饪）低温浸煮的，水波煮的
examples: There's going to be my char, poached with a wood sorrel sauce.
She ordered the poached eggs for breakfast.

words.trans: n. 酸模（酢浆草，一种野生草本，味道清新带酸味，西餐传统香草）
examples: My char, poached with a wood sorrel sauce.
The salad was garnished with fresh wood sorrel.

words.trans: 收腮，把两颊往里吸、脸颊凹进去。小说里两种场景：1.忍住笑意、憋着不笑，控制表情；2.抽烟斗/抽烟时用力吸气、脸颊自然向内凹陷
examples: He sucked his cheeks in and then expelled a jet of smoke.
She sucked her cheeks in to stop herself laughing.

words.trans: n.[不可数] 木镶板、木护墙板（一整片用来贴墙的木板饰面，不是单独一块小板；英式拼写，美式 paneling）
examples: The cloud swirled against the wood panelling of the cabin.
The room was lined with dark oak panelling.

words.trans: 1.本义把（车子、设备）推出来；2.英式小说引申义动用、搬出（人/方案/招数）
examples: They need to be able to wheel out a crusty old dinosaur.
The company wheeled out its old chairman to charm the press.

words.trans: 一个脾气古板、观念陈旧的老顽固/老古董
examples: They need to wheel out a crusty old dinosaur with local knowledge.
He's a crusty old dinosaur who hates all new technology.

words.trans: 不是单纯“出港”，强调船完成转向、摆开，离开港湾这个动态过程
examples: As the Teal swings out of the bay, I'll be on the port side.
The ferry swung out of the bay and pointed towards the open sea.

words.trans: 左舷（船的左侧，航海术语；starboard 右舷）
examples: I'll be standing on the port side giving a little talk.
The lifeboats are stored on the port side of the ship.

words.trans: 物理距离上的靠近。the human being in closest physical proximity：前面名词已有 the，介词短语内部的最高级可以丢掉 the
examples: I will be the human being in closest physical proximity to Her Majesty.
For safety, keep a respectful physical proximity from the edge.

words.trans: 动植物；当地的植物与动物（flora 植物群，fauna 动物群），书面、演讲、科普高频固定词组
examples: I'll talk about the lake, its history, industry, flora and fauna.
The national park protects the local flora and fauna.

words.trans: 猛地一惊，吓一跳
examples: Tom gave a start, knocking over an empty glass.
She gave a start when the phone suddenly rang.

words.trans: 嘴巴一张一合。小说经典神态描写：想说什么，但震惊、错愕，一时讲不出完整的话
examples: Joel was opening and shutting his mouth, too stunned to speak.
He stood there opening and shutting his mouth like a fish.

words.trans: v. 结结巴巴地说，口吃、吞吐迟疑
examples: 'But ...' stammered Tom.
He was so nervous he began to stammer his answer.

words.trans: 挥手拍走、驱赶
examples: Jim waved his hand as if casually swatting away a fly.
She swatted away the mosquito buzzing around her head.

words.trans: be up for sth 可以被拿来讨论、可供考虑。it wasn’t up for discussion 这事儿没得商量、不容讨论
examples: Tom knew it wasn't up for discussion.
The price is not up for discussion — that's final.

words.trans: n. 大黄（食用大黄，一种蔬菜）
examples: Jim brought out a huge rhubarb and custard cake.
She made a tart with fresh rhubarb from the garden.

words.trans: n. 厚块；厚片（厚实、大块，不是薄薄一片）
examples: He served the cake in generous slabs with cream.
He cut a thick slab of cheese from the wheel.

words.trans: adv. 坚决地；果断地；下定决心地
examples: Jim smiled, teeth clamped on the pipe resolutely.
She resolutely refused to give up despite the setbacks.

words.trans: n. 薄弱环节；软肋；不可靠的人/部分
examples: There were too many unknowns, too many weak links.
A chain is only as strong as its weakest link.

words.trans: 一道道烟痕
examples: He could imagine vivid streaks of smoke emanating from the peaks.
Streaks of smoke drifted lazily from the factory chimneys.

words.trans: v. 散发；冒出；发出（烟、气味、光、情绪）
examples: Vivid streaks of smoke emanating from the peaks.
A warm smell of baking emanated from the kitchen.

words.trans: n. 撞击；碰撞；爆炸冲击
examples: A sudden screaming roar, and then impact.
The car was badly damaged on impact with the wall.

words.trans: adj. 使人平静的；抚慰的；舒缓安心的
examples: The sound of the propeller bubbling away behind him was soothing.
The gentle music had a soothing effect on the baby.

words.trans: adj. 极端的；猛烈的；大刀阔斧的，不惜代价的
examples: He needed a safety net that, however drastic, would protect the Teal.
The government took drastic measures to fight inflation.

words.trans: 固定习语。本义安全网（杂技演员下面的防护网）；比喻义兜底保障、应急防护机制、最后的保险手段，万一别的办法失败它可以起保护作用
examples: He needed a safety net to protect the Teal and all her passengers.
Unemployment benefits act as a safety net in hard times.

words.trans: 习语：大发雷霆、迁怒、发泄怒火，对人/物猛烈攻击
examples: He felt the urge to lash out at something or someone.
In his anger he lashed out at anyone nearby.

words.trans: 仅仅、只不过
examples: In the end, the drones were no more than eyes.
It was no more than a scratch, nothing serious.

words.trans: adj. 1.可悲的；可怜的（同情）  2.差劲的，蹩脚的，让人瞧不起的
examples: Throw back Snakey's slate with its pathetic skull and crossbones.
His excuse for being late was absolutely pathetic.

words.trans: v. 蜷缩，挤在一起；抱团
examples: Maggie was huddled in the bow, arms around Archie.
The lost hikers huddled together for warmth.

words.trans: 固定短语，挣脱、挪开身体部位，离开对方
examples: The dog pulled his head away from her.
She pulled away from him when he tried to hug her.

words.trans: adv. 立刻；当即；一瞬间。强调几乎没有时间间隔，一刹那之间就发生，文学小说高频
examples: Instantly, Tom knew what he had to do.
The door flew open instantly at the sound of the bell.
